question: What is the average total quantity across all final packaging combinations, considering only the leaf-level items within each combination after fully expanding any nested packaging relationships?
sql:
-- Now calculate the average total quantity across all final packaging combinations
WITH RECURSIVE hierarchy AS (
    SELECT p.id AS root_id, p.id AS current_id, CAST(1 AS DOUBLE) AS cumulative_qty
    FROM packaging p
    WHERE p.id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT contains_id FROM packaging_relations)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT h.root_id, pr.contains_id AS current_id, h.cumulative_qty * CAST(pr.qty AS DOUBLE)
    FROM hierarchy h
    JOIN packaging_relations pr ON pr.packaging_id = h.current_id
),
root_totals AS (
    SELECT h.root_id, SUM(h.cumulative_qty) AS total_leaf_qty
    FROM hierarchy h
    WHERE h.current_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT packaging_id FROM packaging_relations)
    GROUP BY h.root_id
)
SELECT AVG(total_leaf_qty) AS avg_total_quantity
FROM root_totals;

    SELECT p.id AS root_id, p.id AS current_id, CAST(1 AS DOUBLE) AS cumulative_qty
    FROM packaging p
    WHERE p.id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT contains_id FROM packaging_relations)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT h.root_id, pr.contains_id AS current_id, h.cumulative_qty * CAST(pr.qty AS DOUBLE)
    FROM hierarchy h
    JOIN packaging_relations pr ON pr.packaging_id = h.current_id
)
SELECT h.root_id, p.name AS leaf_name, SUM(h.cumulative_qty) AS total_qty
FROM hierarchy h
JOIN packaging p ON p.id = h.current_id
WHERE h.current_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT packaging_id FROM packaging_relations)
GROUP BY h.root_id, p.name
ORDER BY h.root_id, p.name;
